title: From Latent Biomarkers to Clinical Rules: Embedding-Guided Rule Mining and Attribution-Based Translation for Interpretable Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical decision support tools are most useful when accurate predictions are accompanied by understandable explanations. Rule-based models provide transparency, but rules derived directly from raw clinical measurements may miss patterns arising from interactions between multiple variables. We present a four-step pipeline that mines decision rules in the latent space of an FT-Transformer and translates them back into measurable clinical features. Embedding dimensions that consistently separate patient groups are treated as latent biomarkers, rules are mined using small decision trees, and selected rules are translated using gradient-input saliency and CLS attention attribution. We evaluate the framework on six public clinical and population health datasets at four embedding dimensions. translated_title: 《从潜在生物标志物到临床规则：面向可解释表格学习的嵌入引导规则挖掘与基于归因的翻译方法》
translated_abstract: 临床决策支持工具在提供准确预测的同时还能给出可理解的解释时最为有用。基于规则的模型提供了透明性，但直接从原始临床测量数据中推导出的规则可能遗漏由多个变量之间交互作用所产生的模式。我们提出了一个四步流水线，在FT-Transformer的潜在空间中挖掘决策规则，并将其翻译回可测量的临床特征。持续区分患者群体的嵌入维度被视为潜在生物标志物，使用小型决策树来挖掘规则，并利用梯度输入显著性和CLS注意力归因来翻译选定的规则。我们在四个嵌入维度下，对六个公开的临床和人群健康数据集评估了该框架。翻译后的规则在六个数据集中的五个上优于原始特征规则，平均AUROC提升范围为0.04至0.23。在心脏病数据集上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种四步流水线，在FT-Transformer的潜在空间中挖掘决策规则并借助显著性和注意力归因将其翻译回可测量的临床特征，在六个临床数据集中的五个上比原始特征规则的AUROC平均提升0.04至0.23，实现了准确性与可解释性兼顾的临床决策支持。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a four-step pipeline that mines decision rules from the latent space of an FT-Transformer and translates them back into measurable clinical features using gradient-input saliency and CLS attention attribution, outperforming raw-feature rules with mean AUROC gains of 0.04 to 0.23 on five of six clinical datasets.
